hints: Which letter is the hardest to place, and what happens if you leave it until last?
The most frequent one. Placing it late leaves its copies with nowhere to go, so place it first - and then the next most frequent, and so on.
At each step take the most common letter that is not the one you just placed. A max-heap keyed on the remaining count gives it in O(log 26).
Keep the letter you just used aside for exactly one step, then put it back with its count reduced - that is what stops it being chosen twice in a row.
